title: Solve the undamped constraint rather than divide by linewidth
statement: For L=K-D and E_eta=D+eta I,the source gives the variational lower bound ReR_A>=|<A,u>|²/(<u,E_eta u>+||E_eta^-1/2(K+iomega)u||²),with upper<A,E_eta^-1A>. For uniform nonzero transverse drive,weighted local-energy trials leave exact edge current Jij(vj-vi)(YiZj-ZiYj),leading to graph Laplacian bounds with weights Jij². Smooth acquired observable profile is required,no free eigenvector. Setting B=(I-P0)KP0,C=B†B,w=BC+P0v,u=v+iomega w cancels the undamped residual. Diagonal Pauli supports make C+locally computable by scalar divisions. The false omega²/eta penalty is removed while genuine eta||P0v||² remains. Exact DC,positive linewidth and uncertain coefficients retain separate contracts.
